about: Publisher sites the guard knows before any approval of yours. 'follows': sites a publisher's pages are known to redirect to or serve files from; a batch that includes the site on the left lists them in its approval prompt, as it lists the sites you approved before. 'click': sites where, inside an approved batch, a click in the library browser runs without asking. Add an entry only for a site seen in a real run; a wrong entry widens what one approval covers.
